stories.title: Germany face belgium in Nations League quarterfinals — Klopp plays down favorites tag
stories.summary: Germany coach Jürgen Klopp is looking to "carry positive momentum forward" as his team draw neighboring Belgium in the quarterfinals of the UEFA Nations League.

stories.title: Measles in America: Here's a constructive approach to beating the disease, based on Brazil's experience
stories.summary: The US is now officially a measles contagion zone. By mid-2026, there were more infections than in all of the previous year. But the country could beat measles again, just like Brazil did two years ago.

stories.title: Can German auto manufacturing recover after Mercedes and VW cuts?
stories.summary: German automakers are pulling back on investments at home, sparking fresh anxiety about the auto sector's future. Some industry watchers think there is still a narrow window to stem the decline. But how?

stories.title: Better educated than ever — yet Germany's Gen Z is being shut out of its own future
stories.summary: Never before have young people around the world been so well-educated while facing so many economic challenges. Young Germans are asking: Will I be better off than my parents?

stories.title: Has the 'Parthenon puzzle' been solved? The long quest to reassemble lost eastern pediment
stories.summary: The depiction of the birth of the goddess Athena above the Parthenon's entrance is considered a masterpiece of ancient art. Now, a German research team has pieced together all the surviving fragments.

stories.title: At COP31, conflict over climate science slows action on global warming
stories.summary: Attacks on climate science and disinformation risk delaying key measures at COP31 in Antalya. As the UN climate talks draw to a close, how will that affect efforts to come to an agreement?

stories.title: Repression against Iranian lawyers increases

stories.summary: Bayer could end years of costly lawsuits in the US over claims that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer. Tens of thousands of people could now receive compensation, although some lawyers say the payments are too low.

stories.title: NYC mayor unveils plan to close notorious Rikers Island jail by 2032

stories.summary: One of the most fraught debates at the UN climate talks in Turkey has revolved around the future of coal, oil and gas. Now, all mention of fossil fuels has been removed from the summit's new draft agreement.
